name: @kgec-edu/webs
description: Unified Design System & Component Library for Kalyani Government Engineering College (KGEC)

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/components dist/tokens && cp src/css/webs.css dist/webs.min.css && cp src/webs.js dist/webs.js && cp src/components/* dist/components/ && cp -r assets dist/ && echo 'Build complete'
scripts.test: echo 'webs design system tests passed' && exit 0

author: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, KGEC
